title: Gojoseon
capsule: Gojoseon was the first kingdom of ancient Korea, traditionally founded in the second millennium BC and centered on the Liaodong and northern Korean peninsula. In its later Wiman Joseon phase it controlled trade between the Han Chinese and peninsular and Manchurian peoples. It was conquered by Han Wudi in 108 BC, after which the Han commanderies were established.
